sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The What-If Simulator lets Controllers and Executives model hypothetical portfolio scenarios without affecting live data. It operates in three phases: Scenario Manager (browse/create), Scenario Workspace (build and analyze), and Comparison View (side-by-side analysis).

sections.title: Scenario Manager
sections.body: The landing view shows your saved scenarios and published scenarios from others. Each scenario card shows its name, author, status (private/published), and headline impact. Create a new scenario from scratch or clone an existing one. Delete scenarios you own. Publish scenarios to make them visible to other Controllers and Executives.

sections.title: Scenario Workspace
sections.body: The workspace has a split layout: an action panel on the left and an impact dashboard on the right. Add actions to model changes, and the impact dashboard updates immediately with the recalculated results.

sections.title: Actions
sections.body: Actions can target individual projects or the entire portfolio. Types include: Delay Project, Remove Project, Reduce Budget, Cut Consulting, Accelerate Project, Add Budget, and Across-the-Board Cut. Each action specifies parameters (e.g., delay by N months, reduce by X%). Every action returns the full recalculated scenario state.

sections.title: Impact Dashboard
sections.body: Shows the cascading effects of all applied actions: total budget delta, number of projects affected, FTE impact, RAG status changes, and capacity utilization shifts per cost center. Drill down into any metric to see project-level detail.

sections.title: Comparison View
sections.body: Select up to 3 scenarios to compare side-by-side. The comparison shows key metrics (budget, timeline, capacity, RAG changes) for each scenario in parallel columns. This helps decision-makers evaluate trade-offs between conservative and aggressive approaches.

sections.title: AI Advisor
sections.body: The AI Advisor panel (collapsible, right side) lets you describe a goal in natural language — for example, 'Find 2M in savings' or 'Get all teams below 95% utilization'. The system matches your goal to pre-computed solution paths and presents 2-3 options with different trade-offs. Select a path to apply its constituent actions to your scenario.

sections.title: Important Notes
sections.body: Scenarios are sandboxes — they never affect live portfolio data. All impact calculations are performed server-side. Pre-built scenarios use pre-computed snapshots for instant loading. The AI Advisor uses pattern matching, not a live AI model.
